exposure: vault toilet at home in childhood
unpaved roads around the house in childhood
cohort: 548 patients with PBC and 548 age- and sex-matched controls
finding: Poor environmental hygiene in childhood (vault toilets and unpaved roads), chronic exposure to chemicals (smoking and hair dye use), a history of any autoimmune disease, and a family history of PBC were associated with an increased risk of PBC, while a history of Cesarean section was associated with a decreased risk.
mod_finding: History of Cesarean section was associated with a decreased risk of primary biliary cholangitis.
